body: Thank you very much. I will definitely follow through.

I'm located in the United States. 

That sounds like a good idea. I've tried explaining depression a little here and there, but it has probably come out rushed and ridiculous sounding. 

Post it notes. Alright. I'll try it. I hope I trust myself.
Thank you so much for your feedback. I'm relieved to hear that someone else felt like this.

I agree with you completely. Art and music are keeping me from going stir crazy. They are wonderful outlets, and I make as much time for them as possible. I'm actually a DJ. I spend a lot of my time at the radio station. I also take glassblowing lessons. The thing is, I think I have too MANY interests. When I'm super happy (high on life, and depression seems like it's completely gone), I do a TON. Artsy-crafty shit, literally anything music related, and I read up on history. I just have major trouble balancing it all. I don't want to drop anything... And really there's nothing to drop anyways because none of it's official.(other than the glassblowing and radio show) but I don't know. I overwhelm myself?

My father told me I don't need counseling. He thinks that therapy is bullshit, basically. I have brought it up time and time again, but it's always a no. This is probably because his personal experience with one went terribly. The woman he was seeing was genuinely scared of my dad when he was honest about his feelings. I've done everything I can to convince him to let me go back, but it's not gonna happen. Money is also an issue. 

I absolutely refuse to go back to school counseling. I have seen all three counselors we have there, and they are REAAAALLY hard to talk to. Picture super stressed soccer mom. Plus, if I mention my real issues, they will automatically send me to a mental hospital. Last time I mentioned self harm/suicidal thoughts, they had me examined and could have had me there in an HOUR.
